title: Capability Release Compact
statement: A domestic compact governs transitions from bounded research into public, commercial, military, governmental, or other consequential use.

title: Rival laboratories provide the technical attack surface
statement: Qualified competitors receive controlled access sufficient to attack a frontier applicant's case; the government adjudicates and competitors do not hold a veto.

title: Safety becomes part of the profit function
statement: Because above-frontier monetization depends on passing hostile review, controllability becomes a production input rather than only a cost.

title: Compute stock and compute entanglement differ
statement: Reversibility depends on both the quantity of strategic hardware and the degree to which civilian society depends on its continued operation.

title: Unauthorized agency can be made epistemically valuable
statement: Predefined boundaries around external agency create high-value warning signals when systems cross them without legitimate authorization.

title: International cooperation can deepen in stages
statement: Cooperation progresses from tacit public-frontier reciprocity to narrow abstention, incident exchange, reciprocal review, hardware declarations, activation rules, and only later treaty-level restraints.

title: A/H/P separability remains actionable
statement: There is a policy-relevant interval in which algorithmic progress does not automatically create uncontainable access to hardware and external power.

title: Rival review has positive safety value after proliferation costs
statement: Controlled competitor access reduces undetected risk and concentration more than it increases leakage, proliferation, collusion, and aggregate acceleration.

title: The foreign public frontier is measurable enough to govern
statement: Practical foreign capability can be observed across domains with sufficient reliability to serve as one input to domestic safe-harbor decisions.

title: Physical activation latency can preserve reversibility
statement: Declared reserve hardware can be stored so covert activation takes longer than independent detection and effective response.

title: Domestic benefits can sustain the institution
statement: Predictable release rules, competition, taxation, safer deployment, and protection against foreign release can create a durable domestic constituency.

title: Architecture-neutral unauthorized-agency boundary
statement: Define prohibited external agency by observable actions rather than model architecture or legal labels.

title: Surveil, preserve, and report
statement: Require affirmative surveillance, automatic evidence preservation, prompt reporting on reasonable suspicion, a reporting safe harbor, and severe penalties for concealment.

title: Weights-as-bond review process
statement: The applicant stakes controlled technical access to its candidate system as the price of seeking above-frontier release.

title: Observable uncommissioned hardware reserve
statement: Store reserve accelerators uninstalled, unracked, unnetworked, and detached from dedicated power and cooling, subject to independent observation.

title: Separate gate for the AI industrial survival chain
statement: Scrutinize automation that removes independently controlled human dependencies over compute, power, fabrication, repair, logistics, and reproduction.

title: Seven-stage international ladder
statement: Implement public reciprocity, capability abstention, incident exchange, reciprocal review, hardware declarations, activation controls, and treaty restraint in that order.

title: Licensed compute deployment and data-center taxation
statement: Use deployment licensing as an administrative and potentially populist tax base for large data centers.

title: Separate capability, substrate, and power
statement: Algorithmic capability (A), strategic hardware (H), and power-conversion affordances (P) are related but distinct variables and should not be governed as though they always change together.

title: Pace conversion into irreversible power
statement: The objective is to slow and condition the conversion of frontier intelligence into irreversible economic, political, military, and physical power, not to freeze intelligence as such.

title: Govern bounded research and consequential use differently
statement: Research inside genuinely bounded environments may proceed under a different regime from public, commercial, military, governmental, or otherwise power-conferring use.

title: Require adversarial assurance above the public frontier
statement: Consequential use that materially exceeds the observable foreign public capability frontier requires an adversarial control and safety case.

title: Start domestically and remain internationally extensible
statement: The regime should begin as a domestically justified institution that can operate without foreign agreement and later admit deeper reciprocal cooperation.

title: Make foreign public capability an automatic reciprocity input
statement: Observable foreign public capability should alter the domestic safe-harbor frontier so that foreign restraint can be reciprocated without a treaty and foreign release cannot exploit unilateral domestic restraint indefinitely.

title: Maximize warning time
statement: Governance should maximize the interval between credible detection of a dangerous transition and the point at which humans can no longer respond effectively.

title: How should practical public capability be measured?
statement: Define domain, reliability, autonomy, cost, scaffolding, accessibility, and deployment conditions for frontier equivalence.

title: What access makes adversarial review credible without unacceptable leakage?
statement: Determine the minimum reproducible access, security, and adjudication protocol.

title: How many independent human vetoes are enough?
statement: Determine when energy, compute, fabrication, repair, logistics, and governance dependencies are genuinely independent.

title: When does capability itself collapse A/H/P separability?
statement: Identify architectures or behaviors that make power boundaries infeasible before formal review.
